title: LSA-PAST: Layer-Specific Adaptation and Prototype Transport for Compositional Incremental Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) enables models to recognize new classes over time while retaining prior knowledge, but many real-world problems are compositional, where visual concepts arise from combinations of primitives such as states (i.e., red, shiny) and objects (i.e., shoe, car). Standard CIL methods treat each composition as an independent class, ignoring shared primitives and providing no mechanism to stabilize their representations as new compositions arrive. This causes parameter updates to entangle primitives and induce drift that degrades performance on earlier compositions. Compositional Incremental Learning (composition-IL) formalizes this setting by introducing new state-object compositions across tasks. In this paper, we propose Layer-Specific Adaptation with Prototype-Anchored Adapter-Space Transport (LSA-PAST), a parameter-efficient method tailored to composition-IL. translated_abstract: 类别增量学习使模型能够在识别新类别的同时保留已有知识，但许多现实世界的问题具有组合性，即视觉概念源自基元的组合，例如状态（如红色、闪亮）和物体（如鞋子、汽车）。标准的类别增量学习方法将每个组合视为独立类别，忽略了共享基元，并且缺乏在新组合到来时稳定其表示的机制。这导致参数更新使基元相互纠缠并引发表示漂移，从而降低模型在早期组合上的性能。组合式增量学习通过在各任务间引入新的状态-物体组合来形式化这一场景。在本文中，我们提出了带有原型锚定适配器空间传输的层级特定适配方法（LSA-PAST），这是一种专为组合式增量学习设计的参数高效方法。LSA将低秩适配集成到一个冻结的
tldr: 提出LSA-PAST方法，通过层级特定的LoRA适配与原型锚定的适配器空间传输，在组合式增量学习中稳定共享基元表示、防止漂移，实现参数高效的学习。
